svg.title: Patchy contest — 039 / Before the weights reveal — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 039 / Before the weights reveal, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: SYMBOLS LIE ON THE GROUND, UNDER THE FOG
THE READER HAS REACHED THE RECURRENCE. THE JUNE RESPONSE HAS NOT.
032.5; 035.4; 038.5 / recurrence documented; independence inferred · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
